text:
Samara: Big personal news  baby arrived this morning! Mom + baby are doing well. 493 Were home now, short naps, lots of swaddles.
Jon: AH CONGRATS SAMARA!! :tada: any name updates yet? Sending so much love.
Samara: not yet decided, leaning toward Flora or June. open to suggestions :)
Asha: Flora is gorgeous. sending food? can drop off meals this week.
Priya: congrats!! what do you need most? groceries? bottles?
Samara: honestly help with meals and a little grocery top-up would be amazing. also would love a card from the team.
Noor: i can organize a meal train spreadsheet + chip in on groceries.
Lina: ill pick up frozen meals tomorrow morning, whats your preferred delivery window?
Samara: anytime after 5pm is perfect for drop-offs. thank you all.
HR-bot: Parental leave reminder  Samara is eligible for 12 weeks paid parental leave. See the benefits page: https://intranet.example.com/leave
Priya: quick Q  do we want to do a group card + gift? if yes, i can start a split for contributions.
Noor: yes to card + group gift. ill make a tiny Google form to collect messages for the card.
Asha: vote for gift type: baby essentials (diapers + wipes) / gift card / keepsake toy?
Jon: diapers + wipes feels most useful to me.
Lina: gift card also good if were unsure of sizes.
Samara: diapers would be so helpful, thanks. sizes newborn + 1. appreciate everyone so much.
Noor: created form: https://forms.example.com/samara-card (please add a short message by EOD Wed)
Asha: ill add a short note and order some diapers tonight.
HR-bot: Reminder: teammates can book a 15-min check-in slot to plan coverage while Samara is out. See #eng-schedule for swapping.
Samara: thanks again  really touched. also small ask  if folks want to visit, DM me first please  newborn naps are sacred lol.
Jon: totally. virtual cuddles accepted :heart: 
Priya: sending a tiny care package from me and Noor this week :)
